packets.title: Additive-assisted islet recovery benchmark on a fixed base cryomix
packets.decisionQuestion: Should Atlas prioritize "Additive-assisted islet recovery benchmark on a fixed base cryomix" as the main head-to-head wedge benchmark?
packets.whyNow: Best current wedge in islets. The literature is strong enough to justify a focused additive benchmark, but not strong enough to claim a winning adjunct yet.
packets.claim: Several islet papers imply that recovery gains may come from adjuncts added around a standard cryomix rather than from entirely new base CPA chemistry.
packets.proposedExperiment: Run a fixed-backbone additive benchmark with p38 MAPK inhibitor, Trehalose, Beraprost Sodium, Polyvinyl Pyrrolidone on a DMSO-centered base mix, using post-thaw function as the primary readout.

packets.title: Matched-species islet vitrification vs slow-freezing benchmark
packets.decisionQuestion: Would "Matched-species islet vitrification vs slow-freezing benchmark" materially sharpen the wedge decision if tested next?
packets.whyNow: This remains one of the highest-signal next experiments in the current domain slice.
packets.claim: The current islet corpus overweights slow-freezing, so a matched-species comparison is needed to separate real vitrification gains from endpoint and species confounding.
packets.proposedExperiment: The cleaned islet slice contains many slow-freezing studies, a smaller vitrification set, and a few comparative papers. A direct benchmark with the same species and the same post-thaw function readout is the fastest way to convert that literature asymmetry into actionable signal.

packets.title: Promote islet function-heavy protocols to transplantation endpoints
packets.decisionQuestion: Would "Promote islet function-heavy protocols to transplantation endpoints" materially sharpen the wedge decision if tested next?
packets.whyNow: This remains one of the highest-signal next experiments in the current domain slice.
packets.claim: Several islet protocols that look promising on insulin secretion or in-vitro function will reorder once they are compared on graft or transplantation outcomes.
packets.proposedExperiment: The curated islet slice now has better function labeling than transplantation coverage. Converting the strongest in-vitro function protocols into a small transplantation benchmark is likely higher-signal than inventing a new chemistry path immediately.
